items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Alphonso Trent only in the context of the interviewer discussing 'Stuff' (likely Stuff Smith) and his previous bands. The interviewee, Cozy Cole, does not speak about Alphonso Trent, nor is there any evidence in the text that Cozy Cole personally knew, met, or collaborated wi

ctx.x: After Willie. Now, I met Stuff in Buffalo, at the time I was with Willie Bryant. We was working this club in Buffalo that I couldn't think of the name, and Stuff is out of Buffalo, that's his home. He used to come by down at the Union and Stuff and I used to sit downstairs and jam in the afternoon, and that's how we become acquainted.
Was he still with Alphonso Trent or was that later?

I think so, Alphonso Trent and then he had a little trio somewhere over at Toppy's there in Buffalo. He and Jonah and all them, I met Jonah at the same time. And I don't think he was with Alphonso Trent then.
